market.title: JD Vance — 2028 U.S. Presidential Election Winner
resolutionNote: Resolves to whoever is inaugurated President in January 2029, based on AP/Fox/NBC race calls.

text: Vance hit an all-time-high of 33% last October but has declined throughout 2026, dropping behind Rubio for the first time in July.
Trump's circle and the general public aren't sure about Vance, and it has shown in approval ratings hitting a new low in April.
He has had many controversial moments this year, including alleging the Epstein case was "mishandled" and insulting Michelle Obama.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
